service.name: org.moqui.ai.mcp.LayoutServices.modify#Blueprint
service.description: Modify or update a blueprint layout tree on the server and sync to disk XML.

actions.script:
String targetUri = artifactUri ?: artifactPath String activeUserId = ec.user.getUserId() ?: "system_ide_user"
// 1. Store updated blueprint into WorkspaceBuffer ec.service.sync().name("org.moqui.ide.AgiWorkspaceServices.store#WorkspaceBuffer") .parameters([artifactUri: targetUri, userId: activeUserId, metaJsonBuffer: metaJsonData]) .call()

service.description: Centralized service to hydrate, mutate, and persist the active Meta-JSON tree buffer.
Use this tool when the user requests to add, create, or insert a new input field into the active layout tree.

service.name: org.moqui.ai.mcp.LayoutServices.get#ScreenArchetypeList
service.description: Discovers and lists all canonical screen archetypes available in the workspace. Returns archetype names, URIs, and layout descriptions for the AI to choose from during planning.

service.name: org.moqui.ai.mcp.LayoutServices.get#ScreenArchetype
service.description: Retrieve the XML blueprint content of a specific canonical screen archetype to guide layout generation.

parameter.name: archetypeId
parameter.description: The ID or name of the archetype (e.g. 'master-detail', 'lookup-modal', 'find-and-list').
